title: Computational screening of appealing perspectives of indium-based halide double perovskites In2AgSbX6 (X = Cl, Br, and I) for energy harvesting technologies

The indirect band gaps (Eg) of 1.95 eV, 1.35 eV, and 0.78 eV and primary absorption α(ω) peaks in the visible region suggest that the In2AgSbX6 (X = Cl, Br, and I) is suitable for solar cells.
